clue.text: Page one is about undercover work

indicators.note: about here means turned around, so the letters of page one is are rearranged

explanation.surface: A front-page story concerns a spying operation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' signals rearranging the nine letters of PAGE ONE IS; 'is' looks like a link verb but is part of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Spying is secret, covert work carried out by agents in disguise.

clue.text: Dolt is upset showing little or no emotion

indicators.note: upset means knocked over or disturbed, so the letters of dolt is are jumbled

explanation.surface: A dim-witted person is shaken yet shows no feeling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' signals rearranging DOLTIS; 'is' looks like the verb of the sentence but is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A stolid person is impassive, displaying hardly any feeling.

clue.text: Disregard Italian gentleman losing his head

indicators.note: losing his head means the gentleman's word drops its first letter

parts.note: signore is the Italian word for a gentleman or mister

explanation.surface: Pay no attention to the Italian man who has lost his composure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing his head' removes the S from SIGNORE. 'losing his head' suggests panic, but it is a deletion of the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To ignore something is to take no notice of it, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Ordinary apprentice supporting opera

indicators.note: in a down clue a piece that supports another sits beneath it

parts.note: Norma is Bellini's opera
L for learner, an apprentice driver's plate

explanation.surface: A humdrum trainee is backing a production at the opera house.
explanation.walkthrough: NORMA is an opera by Bellini; L is the learner plate on British cars.
explanation.definitionFit: Something normal is usual, standard and unremarkable.

clue.text: Getting together in circle encompassing German catchment area

parts.note: a gathering is a getting together of people
a round is a circle

explanation.surface: A meeting in a ring that includes a German is held in a drainage basin.
explanation.definitionFit: A gathering ground is a region whose rainfall drains into a reservoir or river, a watershed.

clue.text: Unlimited round writer finished

parts.note: O is a round shape
a pen is a writing instrument
ended means finished

explanation.surface: A whole round by an author is completed without limit.
explanation.definitionFit: Something open-ended has no fixed limit or conclusion.

clue.text: Receptacle with eyepiece that is stereoscopic

parts.note: a bin is a container or receptacle
an ocular is the eyepiece of an optical instrument

explanation.surface: A container fitted with a lens gives a three-dimensional view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' and 'that is' are link words joining the pieces to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Binocular vision uses both eyes, giving depth perception like a stereoscope.

clue.text: Preserve indeed found in lake in Wales, it's a spicy dish

parts.note: jam is a fruit preserve

indicators.note: found in means the word for indeed is placed within the lake's name

parts.note: Bala is the largest natural lake in Wales
ay, or aye, means yes indeed

explanation.surface: Jam discovered in a Welsh lake turns out to be a hot meal.
explanation.walkthrough: AY goes inside BALA to make BALAYA. Bala Lake (Llyn Tegid) is in north Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Jambalaya is a spiced Creole rice dish with meat or seafood.

clue.text: From maintop, remove name having most favourable points

indicators.note: from signals the answer is made out of the letters of maintop once something is removed

explanation.surface: A sailor told to clear a name off the top of the mast finds the best spots.
explanation.walkthrough: MAINTOP, the platform at the head of a ship's mainmast, loses N ('remove name'), and the remaining MAITOP is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Optima are the best or most advantageous conditions, plural of optimum.

clue.text: Current speed?

parts.note: reads as how fast a river or electric flow moves, but current means present-day and speed a price level

explanation.definitionFit: The going rate is the usual present price for a job or item.

clue.text: Place in a grave situation

parts.note: seems to mean put someone in a serious predicament, but grave is literal, a burial plot

explanation.definitionFit: To bury a body in a tomb is to inter it.

clue.text: One may not hear what another has to say

definitions.text: One may not hear what another has to say

parts.words: One may not hear what another has to say
parts.note: sounds like an inattentive listener, but describes a deaf person who follows speech by watching mouths

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who understands speech by watching mouth movements, often a deaf person.

clue.text: Cancel article appearing in book

indicators.note: appearing in means the article sits inside the cancel word

parts.note: annul means cancel or invalidate
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: An instruction to strike out a newspaper article that has been printed in a book.
explanation.walkthrough: A goes inside ANNUL, between U and L.
explanation.definitionFit: An annual is a book published once a year, especially for children.

clue.text: Drink on board

parts.note: suggests a drink served on a ship, but board means a dining table

explanation.definitionFit: Ordinary wine served with meals at the dinner table.

clue.text: Slave-like deference of riotous liver in said city

indicators.note: in means the shuffled letters go inside the spoken city word
said means the word city is spoken, giving letters that sound like it

parts.note: city said aloud sounds like SITY

indicators.note: riotous means wild and disorderly, so the letters of liver are rearranged

explanation.surface: A wild drinker's liver ends up fawning in a town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'riotous' turns LIVER into ERVIL, which goes inside SITY, a spelling of how 'city' is pronounced ('said').
explanation.definitionFit: Servility is fawning, slavish obedience to others.

clue.text: Sees coils wrapped round triangle

indicators.note: wrapped round suggests twisting, so the letters of sees coils are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone notices coils of wire wound around a three-sided shape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrapped round' signals rearranging SEESCOILS; the definition is a type of triangle.
explanation.definitionFit: An isosceles triangle has two equal sides; the word names that kind of three-sided figure.

clue.text: Lady from Malta going to Iowa

parts.note: M is Malta's international vehicle code
IA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Iowa

explanation.surface: A woman travels from Malta to the American Midwest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' and 'going to' only join the pieces in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Mia is a woman's first name, a lady.

clue.text: After short time a flightless bird appears

indicators.note: after here means the a follows the short time

parts.note: mo is short for moment, a brief time

explanation.surface: Moments later a bird that cannot fly turns up.
explanation.definitionFit: The moa was a huge extinct New Zealand bird that could not fly.

clue.text: Satisfied consumer demand

parts.note: sounds like a market phrase, but a consumer satisfying a demand for food did so by eating

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has eaten has consumed food and satisfied hunger.

clue.text: Treatment one is disinclined to have had?

definitions.text: Treatment one is disinclined to have had?

parts.words: Treatment one is disinclined to have had?
parts.note: reads as a treatment nobody wants, but describes therapy that makes one averse to a habit

explanation.definitionFit: Therapy that pairs a habit with unpleasant stimuli to create a dislike of it.

clue.text: Get on with one, say, on the rebound

parts.note: a means one

indicators.note: on the rebound means bouncing back, so the abbreviation for say is read backwards

parts.note: eg, for example, means say

explanation.surface: Get along with someone, for instance, after a break-up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the rebound' turns EG round to GE, which follows A.
explanation.definitionFit: To get on is to grow older, a sense of 'get on in years'.

clue.text: Extravagant six hit out

indicators.note: out means the hit word stands outside the roman six

parts.note: lash means hit or strike
VI is six in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A batsman hits a lavish six out of the ground.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' puts LASH outside VI. 'hit out' reads as a single phrase, 'lash out', but 'out' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Lavish means sumptuous, generous to excess.

clue.text: Starry Stella, we hear

explanation.surface: A starry woman named Stella, so people say.
explanation.walkthrough: Stella sounds like 'stellar', which means relating to stars, as the answer does.
explanation.definitionFit: Astral and stellar both mean relating to the stars; Stella is pronounced like 'stellar'.

clue.text: Instrument not in the drink

indicators.note: not means the word in is removed from the instrument

parts.note: a clarinet is a woodwind instrument

explanation.surface: A musician leaves the instrument out of the drinking session.
explanation.definitionFit: Claret is red Bordeaux wine, a drink.

clue.text: In excavation, find nothing of the plant

parts.note: a dig is an archaeological excavation
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: An archaeologist digging finds nothing but plant remains.
explanation.definitionFit: Indigo is a plant grown for its blue dye.

clue.text: Getting to grips with one's opponent

definitions.text: Getting to grips with one's opponent

parts.words: Getting to grips with one's opponent
parts.note: reads as tackling a rival's arguments, but describes literally grappling bodily

explanation.definitionFit: A combat sport in which two people grapple and try to throw each other.

clue.text: She takes things in her stride

definitions.text: She takes things in her stride

parts.words: She takes things in her stride
parts.note: sounds like a calm person, but describes someone literally striding along on foot

explanation.definitionFit: A pedestrian or hiker goes about on foot, step by step.

clue.text: Take care of bird finding safety barrier

parts.note: guard means protect or take care of
a rail is a wading bird

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher looks after a bird by a protective fence.
explanation.definitionFit: A guardrail is a protective rail preventing falls.

clue.text: Spice girl hazel perhaps initially

indicators.note: initially means the nut comes first, before the girl

parts.note: a hazel is a nut, given as an example
Meg is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A Spice Girl may be called Hazel, at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spice girl' reads as the pop group, but Spice is the definition and girl gives MEG.
explanation.definitionFit: Nutmeg is a spice from the seed of a tropical tree.

clue.text: Flattery from a grown-up going round I take on

indicators.note: going round means the adult word surrounds the letter a

parts.note: an adult is a grown-up

explanation.surface: Praise from an adult surrounding me that I accept.
explanation.walkthrough: ADULT goes round A to give ADULAT; 'take' joins I and ON.
explanation.definitionFit: Adulation is excessive admiration or praise.
